item.title: ARMA Announces New Executive Committee, Board of Directors for 2026-27
item.description: The Asphalt Roofing Manufacturers Association (ARMA) names its new leadership through 2027. See who's on the list!

item.title: Royalty Roofing USA Acquires Michigan’s Division 7
item.description: The acquisition supports Royalty Roofing USA’s national growth strategy, expanding its commercial roofing footprint across Michigan and the broader Midwest while integrating Division 7’s long-established regional presence.

item.title: 5 maneras de mantener el impulso para los contratistas de techado latinos
item.description: Luciano Pérez, veterano líder en seguridad de techado, ofrece cinco maneras de mantener el impulso positivo para los techadores latinos.

item.title: De Venezuela a Texas: El Ascenso de Level Up Roofing
item.description: Rafael Riera y Johana Ramos dejaron Venezuela en busca de seguridad y oportunidades. Sin experiencia en techado, lanzaron Level Up Roofing en Texas, una empresa que ahora crece rápidamente y se prepara para grandes proyectos comerciales en 2026.

item.title: Contratistas de techado latinos celebran en los Premios NRCA 2026
item.description: La comunidad latina del techado estuvo bien representada en la ceremonia de premiación de la NRCA/Alliance 2026.

item.title: Learn the 4 Priorities Credit Pros Can’t Ignore
item.description: Trade credit in 2025 left many companies dizzy and unsure how to operate efficiently. “Credit Overlord” Thea Dudley examines how to refocus credit and collections for 2026 with tech and boosted morale.

item.title: SRS Para Latinos Reconoce a Líderes del Techado en los Premios Contractor Success 2026
item.description: SRS Para Latinos celebró la excelencia latina en el techado durante IRE 2026 al reconocer a empresas y líderes que están impulsando el crecimiento, la innovación y el liderazgo dentro de la industria.

item.title: Roofing Firms Donate New Roof to Domestic Violence Shelter
item.description: Materials and labor donations replaced a failing roof at Family Renewal Shelter, allowing staff to focus on helping families affected by domestic violence.

item.title: Christopher Griffin on Three Decades at USG
item.description: In an exclusive conversation, Griffin looks back on growth, reinvestment, and why putting people first has always mattered more than titles.

item.title: Owens Corning University Introduces Virtual Reality Training
item.description: Owens Corning University expands its digital education lineup with OCU VR, an immersive, bilingual training experience that allows roofing professionals to learn and master critical installation skills in a safe, on-demand virtual environment.
